events.title: Infinite Loop is in Steam Next Fest
events.summary: Hi everyone, I'm the developer of Infinite Loop.Infinite Loop is part of this Steam Next Fest (Oct 19 – 26). The free demo is available now — you can play the first map from start to finish, and the levels, skills, and talents you earn in the demo will carry over to the full game, exactly as they are.About the full releaseThe full game launches within 1–2 weeks after Next Fest ends.
